headline: Profit returns as charges fade, but demand stays uneven
summary_short: Park Hotels & Resorts' Q1 FY2026 revenue was $622M, down 1.3% y/y, while GAAP EPS swung to $0.05 from a $0.29 per-share loss a year earlier as a much smaller impairment charge and the absence of a 2025 defaulted-loan interest expense lifted the bottom line.
summary_long: Revenue fell 1.3% y/y to $622M as gains at the Bonnet Creek complex, Hawaii hotels and the Caribe Hilton were offset by declines in New Orleans (lapping the 2025 Super Bowl) and Miami, where the Royal Palm stays closed for renovation until June 2026. Net income swung to $11M ($0.05 diluted EPS) from a $57M loss, mainly on a smaller impairment ($5M vs $70M) and the absence of a 2025 defaulted-mortgage interest charge. Nareit FFO/share rose to $0.39 from $0.33; Adjusted FFO/share slipped to $0.45 from $0.46. Operating cash flow fell 31% y/y to $59M on lower occupancy and receipt timing. Cash fell to $156M; debt held flat near $3.85B. No formal 2026 guidance was disclosed.
